summary: Brookfield Oaktree Holdings (BOH) filed an 8-K announcing a Transaction Agreement (April 14, 2026) whereby all outstanding limited partnership interests and equity awards of Oaktree Capital Group Holdings, Oaktree Equity Plan, and Oaktree Equity Plan II will be acquired or cancelled. Consideration comprises cash, Class A shares of Brookfield Asset Management Ltd. (BAM) or Brookfield Corporation (BN), limited partnership interests of ExchangeCo, and/or BAM RSUs. Structural details include an ExchangeCo and a sale of Oaktree Capital I GP to Brookfield US Company. No financial terms, premium, or board recommendation disclosed. Watch for regulatory approvals and closing mechanics; risk-arb focuses on consideration elections and ExchangeCo valuation.
